# SQLite WASM license notice

`sqlite3.mjs` and `sqlite3.wasm` are copied without modification from the official SQLite 3.53.3 WASM distribution.

The SQLite portions use SQLite's public-domain dedication and blessing. The Emscripten glue code uses the MIT and University of Illinois/NCSA open-source licenses. The original notice is preserved at the beginning of `sqlite3.mjs`. The complete Emscripten and musl runtime notices are included in [the shared WebAssembly notice](../../../plugins/dsp/NOTICE.txt).

Source: <https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-wasm-3530300.zip>
